description:
Company Overview:

PartsBase Inc. is the world's largest online Aviation Marketplace and Community. Our global community is comprised of over 6,500 companies accessing our technology in over 140+ countries & territories. We work with some of the biggest brands in aviation including Delta, Northrop Gruman, AvAir, Heico, Chevron, Air France Industries, and Air Australia.

PartsBase offers a FULLY remote environment where one can work at the forefront of where the aviation business meets technology. Imagine getting to work with peers worldwide, implementing business technology projects that challenge the boundaries.

Life at PartsBase:

One of the top benefits of working at PartsBase is the culture. We are a TEAM-focused organization, and everyone celebrates each other's successes. Our inclusive culture welcomes all employees and values their unique contributions to our success. Our clients tell us time and time again that our people set us apart from the competition. We naturally strive to hire the very best talent. The ideal candidate is a motivated, well-organized individual who has a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with customers.

About the Role

As a Customer Success Manager on the Government Data team, you will own a book of defense-contractor and supplier accounts. You will protect and grow the revenue we already have, and you will also open new doors.

You will keep customers winning with the platform, lead renewals, and expand usage. You will also prospect and close new Government Data accounts. If you are organized, detail-driven, and energized by both closing new business and keeping customers for the long haul, this role is built for you.

You will know the world of DoD procurement well enough to talk to customers as a peer: NSNs, CAGE codes, DLA solicitations, RFQs and RFPs, and the bid sites contractors live in every day.

What You'll Do

Retain and grow the book

• Own a portfolio of Government Data accounts, managing the relationship from onboarding through renewal

• Lead renewals and protect and grow existing revenue

• Run proactive check-ins, product walkthroughs, and enhancement updates so customers get daily value from search filters, bid matching, CAGE tracking, and analytics

• Spot upsell and cross-sell opportunities, such as additional users, API access, and other PartsBase solutions

• Identify at-risk accounts early and act before they churn

Win new business

• Prospect and close new Government Data accounts among DoD contractors, distributors, manufacturers, and brokers

• Deliver tailored demos that show how PBGD helps customers find, price, and win more bids

• Use government bid sites and procurement data to identify target accounts and time your outreach to live opportunities

• Represent PartsBase at relevant industry events and trade shows

Stay organized and accountable

• Meet regularly with customers and prospects to drive adoption, renewals, and new business

• Keep the CRM accurate and current: activities, opportunities, renewal dates, and account notes

• Report on pipeline, renewal, and new-account activity

• Partner with Marketing, Product, and Support to share customer feedback and sharpen campaigns

What You Bring

• 3–5 years of B2B sales experience covering the full cycle: prospecting, closing, onboarding, renewals, and expansion

• Direct experience selling to the Department of Defense or to defense contractors and suppliers

• Government bidding experience, including responding to RFQs and RFPs

• Working knowledge of government bid sites and procurement sources, such as SAM.gov, DLA DIBBS, and similar bid boards

• A track record of meeting or exceeding quota and renewal targets

• Exceptional organization and attention to detail across a large book of accounts

• Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, including with executive buyers

• Hands-on CRM experience (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and the discipline to keep it current

• Comfort managing a large portfolio of customers and prospects at the same time

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with NSNs, CAGE codes, and DLA solicitations

• Experience with competing government data and bid platforms, such as GovWin, GovTribe, GovSpend, or NSN Now

• Aviation, aerospace, or defense supply-chain background

• Experience with API or data-integration products

• Bachelor's degree in business or a related field

Why Join Us

• Fully remote role with a global, collaborative team

• Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission

• Milestone bonuses and retention incentives

• Comprehensive benefits: health, dental, vision, and 401(k)

• A real product with real impact: your customers use it eight hours a day to win defense contracts

• Career growth in a fast-moving SaaS environment backed by PartsBase, the world's largest aviation marketplace
